# DiveSaveEd

> A free, open-source, native macOS save editor for the game *Dave the Diver*. It edits the
> save file on disk, offline, while the game is closed — it is not a trainer, does not attach
> to the game process, and makes no network calls.

Site URL: https://hypery11.github.io/DaveTheDiverSaveEditor — change this one line if the domain changes; the links below are relative to it.

## Key facts

- **Platform:** macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later. Universal build — Apple Silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
- **Game version:** the **Steam** version of *Dave the Diver* **on macOS** only.
- **Not supported:** Nintendo Switch and PlayStation (console saves, unreadable by this tool). The Xbox / Microsoft Store version isn't available for Mac at all.
- **Price / licence:** free, MIT licensed, no ads, no telemetry, no account.
- **Network:** none. It makes no network calls of any kind.
- **Ban risk:** none. *Dave the Diver* is single-player with no multiplayer, no leaderboards and no anti-cheat. The tool never reads or writes game memory and never touches the game executable.
- **Not a Cheat Engine port:** Cheat Engine is Windows-only and has no macOS build. This is a save editor, so it cannot do live effects (godmode, speed); it edits everything that is *persisted*.

## What it edits

Currencies (Gold, Bei, Artisan's Flame, Research Point, Cooksta Follower Count, Trust and Fake
points), plus one-click bulk fills for restaurant ingredients (DLC-aware), branch stock, staff
levels, general items, craft materials, Sea People village, farm seeds and caught-fish grade — or
"Run All Fills" at once. Any single item can be edited by name from a built-in item database.
Safety: refuses to write while the game is running, timestamped backup before every write with a
restore window, in-app undo for bulk actions, change preview, and a **read-only** raw JSON
inspector. Interface in English, 简体中文, 繁體中文 and 한국어.

## Save file location (macOS)

Two layouts exist; the app checks both automatically.

```
~/Library/Application Support/com.nexon.dave/SteamSData/<steam-id>/
~/Library/Application Support/nexon/DAVE THE DIVER/SteamSData/
```

Files are named `GameSave_XX_GD.sav`, where `XX` is the slot number. `~/Library` is hidden in
Finder — open it with Go ▸ Go to Folder… (⇧⌘G).

## The Steam Cloud gotcha

The single most common reason an edit "doesn't work". At launch, Steam sees the local save differs
from the cloud copy and restores the old cloud version over the edit. Correct order: (1) quit the
game completely, (2) turn off *Keep game saves in the Steam Cloud* for Dave the Diver in its Steam
properties, (3) edit and save, (4) launch. The other cause is the opening tutorial, where a few
values are hard-scripted and overwritten.
